items.title: Gucci Seemingly on Cusp of Turnaround
items.summary: Follow-up analysis of Kering's Q2 print describing North America as Gucci's most buoyant market: direct-to-consumer sales in the region grew roughly 9% like-for-like in H1, driven by simultaneous volume and average-price increases plus stronger online demand, with the US alone contributing close to half of that growth; still framed as fragile given the ongoing global store-closure program.

items.title: HSBC Upgrades Kering to Buy Rating, Boosts Price Target
items.summary: HSBC analyst Anne-Laure Bismuth raised Kering to Buy from Hold and lifted the price target to EUR340 from EUR290, citing US strength and the mid-July in-store arrival of Demna's first full collection as reasons momentum should hold, while cautioning HSBC does not expect Gucci to return to outright growth this year.

items.title: France Analyst Views: HSBC Turns Positive Again on Kering
items.summary: Roundup of French sell-side notes following Kering's Q2 beat shows a cluster of price-target hikes (Bernstein to EUR270 from EUR220, Barclays upgraded to Equal Weight with a EUR300 target) as US-led demand and Demna's debut collection reaching stores are cited as the turning point analysts had been waiting for.

items.title: Multinational Luxury Group to Close 100 More Stores Amid Sales Slump
items.summary: Coverage of Kering's continued store-rationalization plan: 84 net closures completed in H1 2026 toward a 100-store full-year target, bringing the group's store count down to 1,635 from 1,719 at end-2025; Gucci is expected to account for the largest share of the cuts even as North America outperforms other regions on a comparable-sales basis.

items.title: Not sure what to do about purchasing a Gucci wallet
items.summary: Active PurseForum thread where a North American member hesitates over buying a Gucci wallet secondhand via Poshmark, seeking peer reassurance on value-for-money; replies reflect ongoing price-sensitivity and value-justification debate among core handbag/SLG community members rather than unqualified enthusiasm.

items.title: 2026 Gucci Flora thread
items.summary: Running PurseForum thread where North American collectors compare the returning Flora print under Demna across Jackie, tote, bucket-bag and GG Marmont silhouettes, debating craftsmanship and pricing versus earlier Flora eras; still an active reference thread into August, used here as continuing community sentiment (not double-counted from a prior single-day snapshot).

items.title: Gucci customer reviews - quality and pricing complaints
items.summary: Aggregated US consumer reviews describing perceived declining quality alongside rising prices, with named defect examples including a GG Marmont buckle/chain chipping within six months and a hat buckle repeatedly popping off; several reviewers argue the brand is overpriced relative to craftsmanship delivered, a persistent critical throughline in the review base.

items.title: What the Resale Data Says About Luxury Gucci Handbags and Their Value Retention
items.summary: Retailer blog analysis (treated as verification-required, not load-bearing alone) arguing Gucci's resale value retention has softened relative to Chanel/Hermes as younger secondhand shoppers gravitate to more affordable contemporary brands; corroborated directionally by mainstream reporting on falling resale prices for heritage logo-driven brands.

items.title: Louis Vuitton, Gucci, Burberry, Chanel, Prada and Dior Are Most Purchased Items on eBay This Year So Far
items.summary: WWD's read of eBay's 2026 resale watchlist places Gucci among the most-searched heritage brands on the platform, though Dior draws specific momentum framing tied to Jonathan Anderson's new role, implicitly positioning Gucci's resale buzz as steady rather than accelerating versus competitors.

items.title: Resale marketplace commentary on Gucci handbag demand
items.summary: SNS post from a handbag resale/consignment account commenting on current market demand and pricing for Gucci bags relative to other heritage brands, part of an ongoing thread of resale-market commentary tracked since prior days; engagement figures not shown on the page as fetched.

items.title: TikTok #gucci tag activity - bag review/unboxing content
items.summary: Aggregate TikTok tag page shows continuing creator activity centered on Gucci bag reviews and styling videos (Dionysus, Vanity top-handle, Borsetto), consistent with a steady product-content SNS volume rather than a single viral spike; individual video-level metrics not accessible without platform API access.

items.title: Gucci Instagram audience analytics snapshot
items.summary: Third-party analytics snapshot of Gucci's official Instagram account audience and engagement trend, used here only as a channel-mix corroboration point for SNS volume; treated as directional and not a substitute for platform-verified engagement numbers.
